tool.name: Beacon2 Individuals
tool.description: retrieve individuals from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query entity --entity individual @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.lookup.mode) == "by_id" --entity-id '$connection.lookup.entity_id' #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query entity --entity individual --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' #if str($connection.mongo_fields.ageGroup) --field 'diseases.ageOfOnset.ageGroup.label=$connection.mongo_fields.ageGroup' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.diseaseCode) --field 'diseases.diseaseCode.label=$connection.mongo_fields.diseaseCode' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.familyHistory) --field 'diseases.familyHistory=$connection.mongo_fields.familyHistory' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.severity) --field 'diseases.severity=$connection.mongo_fields.severity' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.stage) --field 'diseases.stage=$connection.mongo_fields.stage' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.ethnicity) --field 'ethnicity.label=$connection.mongo_fields.ethnicity' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.geographicOrigin) --field 'geographicOrigin.label=$connection.mongo_fields.geographicOrigin' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.identification) --entity-id '$connection.mongo_fields.identification' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.assayCode) --field 'measures.assayCode.label=$connection.mongo_fields.assayCode' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.sex) --field 'sex.label=$connection.mongo_fields.sex' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: entity_id
param.label: Identifier
param.help: As used by that beacon. Identifiers are local to each beacon.

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Fields to match (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: ageGroup
param.label: AGE GROUP
param.help: age af onset, e.g. Adult 18-65 Years Old Matched exactly against diseases.ageOfOnset.ageGroup.label.

param.name: diseaseCode
param.label: DISEASE CODE
param.help: Disease code, Spinocerebellar ataxia 1 Matched exactly against diseases.diseaseCode.label.

param.name: severity
param.label: SEVERITY
param.help: e.g. Profound Matched exactly against diseases.severity.

param.name: stage
param.label: STAGE
param.help: e.g. acute onset Matched exactly against diseases.stage.

param.name: ethnicity
param.label: ETHNICITY
param.help: e.g. European Matched exactly against ethnicity.label.

param.name: geographicOrigin
param.label: GEOGRAPHIC ORIGIN
param.help: e.g. Slovenia Matched exactly against geographicOrigin.label.

param.name: assayCode
param.label: ASSAY CODE
param.help: e.g. Platelets [#/volume] in Blood Matched exactly against measures.assayCode.label.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Retrieves individual records from the beacons you select, or from a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
